newsitem.title: USA: First Commercial sets 5 pct stock div.
newsitem.headline: First Commercial sets 5 pct stock div.

text.p: First Commercial Corp said it would pay a five percent stock dividend and would increase the annual cash dividend on its common stock to $0.96 a share from $0.84.
In a statement, the company said the stock dividend combined with the increased cash dividend would produce a total cash dividend increase of 20 percent for First Commercial shareholders.

The increased cash dividend will be payable on both shares outstanding and new shares issued through the stock dividend. The stock dividend will be payable on November 15 to shareholders of record as of October 31.
The increased cash dividend will be payable on January 2, 1997, to shareholders of record as of December 16, 1996.
The stock dividend and increased cash dividend were unanimously approved by the board of directors during the annual review of dividend-related matters.
